kind.note.description: Item kind, singular, lower case (map aria labels, card meta line)

kind.doc.description: Item kind, singular, lower case (a document)

kind.action.description: Item kind, singular, lower case (a todo)

kind.notes.description: Item kind, plural, used as a filter label

kind.links.description: Item kind, plural, used as a filter label

kind.docs.description: Item kind, plural, used as a filter label

kind.actions.description: Item kind, plural, used as a filter label

kind.meetings.description: Item kind, plural, used as a filter label

etype.person.description: Entity type, lower case: shown as “Dana (person)”

etype.team.description: Entity type, lower case: shown as “Bingo (team)”

etype.term.description: Entity type, lower case (a recurring word or acronym such as MTCS)

due.today.description: Action due today. {day} is a date such as “Fri, Nov 6”

due.tomorrow.description: Action due tomorrow. {day} is a date

due.overdue.description: Action whose due date has passed. {day} is the due date

due.on.description: Action due on a later day. {day} is a date

range.span.description: A date range, both ends inclusive

range.due.description: A due-date filter. {range} is a date or date range

chip.interp.description: How a question was understood, e.g. “🔎 Docs & links · Mon, Oct 26 – Sun, Nov 1 · “mtcs””. {parts} is a list joined with chip.sep

chip.sep.description: Separator between the parts of a summary line (keep the spaces)

chip.actions.description: Filter label: the question is about actions (todos)

chip.owner_me.description: Filter label: actions owned by the user

chip.owner_anyone.description: Filter label: actions owned by anyone

chip.owner_person.description: Filter label: actions owned by the named person

chip.entity.description: Filter label for a person, team, project or topic, e.g. “Bingo (team)”

chip.status_open_recent.description: Filter label: open actions plus those finished in the last 14 days

chip.status_suggested.description: Filter label: suggested actions waiting for review

chip.status_overdue.description: Filter label: actions past their due date

chip.status_all.description: Filter label: actions in any state

chip.terms.description: Filter label: the words searched for (keep the quotes)

chip.not.description: Filter label: a word excluded from the search

chip.unresolved_team.message: No team called “{name}” yet — searching the word instead
chip.unresolved_team.description: The question named a team that doesn't exist in the mind map

chip.unresolved_project.message: No project called “{name}” yet — searching the word instead
chip.unresolved_project.description: The question named a project that doesn't exist

chip.unresolved_person.message: No one called “{name}” yet — searching the word instead
chip.unresolved_person.description: The question named a person who doesn't exist

chip.unresolved.message: Nothing called “{name}” yet — searching the word instead
chip.unresolved.description: The question named something that doesn't exist

relax.range_widened.description: No results in the asked dates, so the search widened. {asked} and {range} are dates or date ranges

relax.range_dropped.message: Nothing from {asked} — showing matches from any time
relax.range_dropped.description: No results in the asked dates, so dates were ignored

relax.kinds_dropped.description: No results of the asked kind (e.g. Docs & links), so all kinds are shown

relax.entities_softened.message: Nothing linked to {names} — showing mentions instead
relax.entities_softened.description: No results linked to the named team/person, so loose mentions are shown

relax.none.message: Nothing matched — try {capture} to save it, or broaden the question
relax.none.description: No results at all. {capture} is the capture trigger, e.g. “mm+”

relax.no_actions_for.description: An actions question about {name} found nothing

cite.deleted.description: Citation chip for an item that no longer exists

cite.private.description: Citation chip for a private item (its title is hidden)

cite.loading.description: Citation chip while the mind map is still loading

cite.aria.description: Accessible name of a numbered citation chip

cite.open.description: Link in an expanded citation that opens the saved web page

cite.map.description: Button in an expanded citation that shows the item on the map

cite.private_note.message: 🔒 Private — only shown on this computer
cite.private_note.description: Expanded citation of a private item

cite.deleted_note.description: Expanded citation of a deleted item

card.aria.description: Accessible name of a Mind Map card

card.op_deduped.description: Card header when the link or doc was saved before. {day} is when

card.op_deduped_plain.description: Card header when the link or doc was saved before (date unknown)

card.op_edited.description: Card header after the user edited an item

card.op_merged.description: Card header after two names were merged

card.op_forgotten.description: Card header after a name was forgotten

card.op_renamed.description: Card header after a name was renamed

card.op_done.description: Card header after an action was completed

card.op_reopened.description: Card header after a done action was reopened

card.op_accepted.description: Card header after a suggested action was accepted

card.op_dismissed.description: Card header after a suggestion was dismissed

card.op_deleted.description: Card header after items were deleted

card.op_private.description: Card header after an item was made private

card.op_shared.description: Card header after an item stopped being private

card.op_annotated.description: Card header after the agent added a summary, terms or actions

card.op_generic.description: Card header for any other change

card.op_undone.description: Card header after the change was undone

card.op_missing.message: This change is no longer in your history.
card.op_missing.description: Card body when the change can't be found

card.n_actions_suggested.message: {n, plural, one {# action} other {# actions}} ({s} suggested)
card.n_actions_suggested.description: Count of actions, {s} of them suggestions

card.truncated.description: The capture was too long and was cut. {n} is a number such as 8,000

card.map.description: Button: show this on the map

card.open.description: Button: open the link, document or window

card.make_private.description: Button: never send this item to the agent

card.make_shareable.description: Button: let the agent see this item again

card.delete.description: Button: delete the item (can be undone)

card.show_more.description: Expands the rest of a long note

card.from.description: Label before the note an action came from

card.owner.description: An action owned by someone else, e.g. “for Dana”

card.suggested.description: State of an action waiting for review

card.item_missing.description: Card body when the item was deleted

map.aria.description: Accessible name of the map card

map.aria_overview.description: Accessible name of the map overview

map.overview.description: Breadcrumb label of the map overview

map.your_map.description: Title of the overview centre card

map.empty_title.description: Overview centre card with no data

map.empty_hint.message: Type {capture} to save a thought, link or todo
map.empty_hint.description: Overview hint. {capture} is the capture trigger, e.g. “mm+”

map.missing.message: This is no longer in your mind map.

map.list.description: Button: show the neighbourhood as a list

map.map.description: Button: show the neighbourhood as a map

map.list_summary.description: Summary of the collapsible list of the map's nodes

map.static.message: Update Kage to navigate the map — or use {cmd}
map.static.description: Footer on hosts that can't re-centre the map. {cmd} is e.g. “mm @name”

map.more.description: Node that shows the next page of a lane

map.more_first.description: Node that goes back to the first page of a lane

map.more_aria.description: Accessible name of the more node. {lane} is a lane name such as Actions

map.more_first_aria.description: Accessible name of the first-page node

map.node.description: Accessible name of a map node, e.g. “team: Bingo”

map.node_state.description: Accessible name of a map node with a state, e.g. “action: Send numbers, open”

map.stat_review.description: Overview node: suggested actions waiting for review

map.stat_actions.message: {n, plural, one {# open action} other {# open actions}}

map.stat_hint.description: Tooltip on an overview count node. {cmd} is e.g. “mm review”

map.count_entities.message: {n, plural, one {# person or topic} other {# people & topics}}
map.count_entities.description: Count of people, teams, projects and topics in the mind map

map.count_actions.message: {n, plural, one {# open action} other {# open actions}}

map.lane_entities.description: Lane name: related people, teams, projects and topics

map.lane_parent.description: Lane name: the note an action came from

map.lane_stats.description: Overview lane name: counts and recent captures

map.empty_parent.description: Empty lane hint: the action isn't part of a note

help.capture.message: Save a thought, link, path or todo. Paste several lines for a brain dump.

help.capture_window.message: Save the window you came from.

help.find.message: Find things, e.g. “which doc spoke about mtcs last week”.

help.actions.message: Your open actions, optionally for one team, project or person.

help.entity.message: Everything about a person, team, project or topic.

help.map.message: Show the map centred on something. Click a node to move there.

help.ask.message: Ask your agent, answered from your notes with sources.

help.private.message: Keep an item private: it's never sent to your agent.

help.filters.description: Help: heading above the filter syntax
